name: Wine Ticket
summary: In Stormwind, Renato Gallina draws customers to his family's shop with Wine Tickets. Present one to Suzetta Gallina for a complimentary bottle of Pinot Noir.

sections.title: Promoting the Family Vintage
sections.body: Near Stormwind's Trade District, Renato Gallina hands out printed tickets to promote the Gallina Winery. The boutique vintage shop sits along the nearby canals. Each ticket offers a complimentary sample of Pinot Noir, drawing curious passersby and newly arrived adventurers to the family business in hope they become loyal customers.

faq.q: What do I do with the Wine Ticket?
aliases: where do i bring wine ticket
faq.answer: Take the Wine Ticket to Suzetta Gallina at the Gallina Winery along the canals in Stormwind's Trade District. She will redeem it for a complimentary bottle of Pinot Noir.
Renato Gallina hands out Wine Tickets near the Trade District to draw customers to his family's wine shop.

faq.q: What kind of wine does the ticket reward?
faq.answer: Present the ticket for a bottle of Pinot Noir, one of the finest wines the Gallina family sells in the kingdom.

angles.text: The Pinot Noir from this ticket pairs well with hearty meats and cheeses gathered throughout the Eastern Kingdoms.
